reviews.text: I recently visited a salon in Sharjah and had a great experience. One of the best and most affordable salons I’ve been to. reviews.author: Mr. Maruf
reviews.text:
My Experience at This Barbershop

I would not recommend this barbershop to anyone who is looking for a good haircut. From my experience, some of the people cutting hair there are trainees who are still learning and receiving training.

The barber also seemed very careless while cutting my hair. The overall service was not good, and I was very disappointed with the result.

I simply told the barber that he was not cutting my hair the way I had asked. I explained how I wanted my hairstyle to look, but he did not follow my instructions properly. Instead of calmly listening to my concern, he became angry with me and started speaking to me disrespectfully.

I believe that if a customer politely explains what they want, the barber should listen and try to understand the customer's request. Getting angry and speaking rudely to a customer is not professional.

If you are thinking about coming to this barbershop because the haircut is cheaper, don't assume that you will necessarily get a good haircut just because the price is low. You could end up wasting your time and being unhappy with your appearance.

Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend this barbershop if you care about getting the hairstyle you asked for and receiving professional customer service. I would personally prefer to pay a little more and go to an experienced barber who listens to customers and respects their preferences.

reviews.author: Ajlaan ck
reviews.text:
Dear Owner,

If there were an option to give zero stars, I would have chosen that.

I visited your salon tonight for a haircut, shave, and facial. Unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience with the barber wearing the maroon cap with the "Dubai" label.

He was extremely rude throughout my visit. What was even more concerning was that he spent most of the time watching Punjabi videos on his phone instead of paying attention to his work. While using a blade on my head, his eyes were on his phone rather than on what he was doing. This is completely unprofessional and could have caused a serious injury.

Because of his rude attitude and unprofessional behavior, I decided to get only the haircut and cancelled the shave and facial that I had originally planned. I did not feel comfortable continuing with the service.

I have been a regular customer at your salon, but after this experience, I will not be returning. I hope you take this feedback seriously and ensure your future customers do not have to go through the same experience.

If you need to verify what happened, please review your CCTV footage in the upstairs
between 10:15 PM and 10:30 PM. It will clearly show the barber's behavior during my service.

I hope you address this issue by providing better training and ensuring your staff treat customers with the professionalism and respect they deserve.

reviews.author: Muneeb Ahmed
reviews.text:
I recently visited Silver City Gents Salon located in Al Nahda Sahara Plaza Block C, Sharjah, The reasons I’m mentioning the exact location is you too must visit the place and know how worth your 5 dhms are , and I must say my experience was genuinely impressive. The salon has a very welcoming vibe, and from the moment I walked in, I was greeted politely by the staff. The waiting time was minimal because their system of handling customers is well organized and smooth. The overall atmosphere feels clean, modern, and comfortable, which immediately gives a good first impression. I felt relaxed and confident that I was in the right place for grooming services.

The haircut service was the highlight of my visit. The barber named Aadil and Rehan (I’ve cut my hair with both ) was extremely skilled and listened carefully to what I wanted before starting. Aadil gave me suggestions that actually suited my face shape and hair type, which showed real experience. The fade and trimming were done with great precision, and the finishing looked very sharp and clean. I also appreciated how patient the barber was, making sure every detail was perfect before completing the style. The system inside the salon is efficient, so you don’t feel rushed or ignored, and everything flows nicely from entry to service completion.

They also offer many additional grooming services such as beard trimming, facials, waxing, hair treatments, and head massage, which makes it a complete men’s grooming spot. I noticed the place is very hygienic, and all tools are properly sanitized. The pricing is reasonable compared to the quality they provide, which makes it worth every dirham. The staff behavior is respectful and friendly, always ready to help and guide you with services if you are unsure. It is rare to find a salon that balances quality, cleanliness, and affordability so well in one place.

Overall, I am very satisfied with my visit to Silver City Gents Salon and will definitely return again. I highly recommend it to anyone in Sharjah looking for a professional haircut and reliable grooming experience.

Truly a trusted salon for consistent quality, great service, and a comfortable grooming experience every single time you visit highly recommended always again.
